verdict.rationale: Bento's CLI and Agent Skills let an agent read runs, list and edit signals, and pull analytics, and the marketing says releases are "scored… in CI." Nothing documents creating a dataset, triggering an eval run, or reading back eval results programmatically. The only published API spec is a placeholder ("OpenAPI Plant Store"), so release scoring and trace reading are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results
